selected_plan.name: 本地合同治理记忆系统
selected_plan.rationale: VELA 源包继续作为源规则层，记忆只通过本地 schema、envctl validator、日报、演化待办、Obsidian/Zotero/Git 记录和用户确认沉淀；外部记忆服务只作为观察中的接口模式，不作为常驻运行态适配器。

design_principles: 记忆先成为候选，再决定是否沉淀。
越用越顺手依靠可验证的偏好、纠错和项目复盘，不依靠无边界吞 transcript。
源规则层在本地 Git 仓；运行态缓存只能派生，不能解释或覆盖规则。
自动落地只处理低风险、可回滚、有日志、有校验的动作。
默认不启用外部记忆常驻服务；记忆先进入本地候选、评分、复盘和验证流程。
默认不开启 LLM 压缩、自动上下文注入、全量 transcript 导入和自动规则写入。
代码结构上下文由 codegraph 索引辅助，不替代 rg、validator、代码审查和 Git 历史。
后台服务必须有健康检查、端口边界、数据目录边界和可停止/可删除路径。

absorbed_patterns: healthcheck and stats as first-class status outputs
file lock and stale lock awareness for future long-running tools
rejected_patterns: Brain MCP as a second memory authority
LanceDB or QMD runtime as a default dependency
destructive forget/cleanup tools without explicit confirmation

absorbed_patterns: heat, occurrence, age and decay metadata
BM25 plus semantic plus RRF as a future optional retrieval idea
rejected_patterns: Qdrant or embedding service as a default runtime
identity or soul layer as research-environment source truth

absorbed_patterns: formation mode and trust tier metadata
rejected_patterns: startup hook that writes user-level directories
monolithic migration script as VELA runtime core
automatic repair that mutates source rules without validation

memory_layers.purpose: 本轮任务的临时路径、失败命令、网页状态和短期上下文。
项目事实、阶段、材料边界和项目内证据链。
用户协作偏好、语言偏好和仅指向源规则的入口提示。
可复用流程、路由修正规则、工具调用顺序和质量清单。
会改变总路由、权限、验证逻辑或稳定性指标的底层规则。
一次性噪声、无证据断言、过时路径、泄密风险项和重复低价值内容。

promotion_rules: 用户明确说以后都这样，才可提高 user_confirmed。
同一模式至少两次跨任务出现，才可从临时信号进入候选。
进入 skill 前必须有最小测试或明确人工确认。
进入 control_kernel 前必须通过 envctl validate cybernetics。
正式学术引用、论文事实和 DOI 不进入普通记忆，必须走 citation gate。
hard_block_rules: 包含 secret、token、cookie、账号细节或验证码状态。
把私有内容写入 Git 源仓。
把一次性聊天噪声写成全局规则。
与 AGENTS、control kernel、citation gate 或 protected runtime paths 冲突。
未核验论文事实试图进入正式引用链。

cross_session_injection_policy: inject only compact summaries, source refs, confidence, and route-stage state
never inject raw full transcripts by default
when route is ambiguous, use injected context only to ask better questions, not to silently switch routes
private or project-specific memories must not become global rules without user confirmation and validator support
confidence_policy: every recalled memory must expose source type, age, occurrence count, and confidence band
low-confidence recall should produce a clarification question instead of an automatic action
conflicting memories are routed to decision_archive review rather than merged silently
task_state_policy: track current route, lifecycle stage, open blockers, last verified gate, and next recommended stage
task status can guide prompts but cannot override research_pipeline_stages or quality gates
completed project lessons enter evolution_backlog or Obsidian through project-retrospective-evolver
cleanup_policy: support list and delete for candidate memories and status reports
expire ephemeral session memories by ttl unless promoted through review
cleanup must preserve git history, validator logs, and protected path records

interface_controls.purpose: 给每条被召回的记忆标明可信度，避免把弱记忆直接当规则使用。
safety_rules: low confidence must ask a clarification question
conflicting recall must enter decision_archive instead of being merged silently
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If confidence metadata is missing, treat the recall as a candidate hint only.

interface_controls.purpose: 记录路线选择、规则升格、拒绝和回滚理由，形成可审计决策档案。
safety_rules: durable rule changes must reference a decision record
rejected or conflicting memories must stay visible for review
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If no decision record exists, do not promote runtime memory into source rules.

interface_controls.purpose: 记录当前任务链条的开始、暂停、完成、转入下一阶段等状态变化。
safety_rules: task tracking is observational and cannot silently start a new route
new chain creation should ask the user for confirmation when intent is ambiguous
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If task tracking is absent, continue with current context and ask before opening a new chain.

interface_controls.purpose: 保存当前路线、研究阶段、阻塞点和下一步建议，帮助新线程快速续接。
safety_rules: task status can guide prompts but cannot override pipeline gates
stage transition should ask the user when the intent is ambiguous
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If task status is missing, ask the user to confirm the current route and stage.

interface_controls.purpose: 支持候选记忆、状态报告和运行态记忆的清理，避免越用越重。
safety_rules: delete requires explicit scope and confirmation
cleanup must not delete Git history, validator logs, protected runtime paths, or source contracts
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If scope or confirmation is missing, report candidates but do not delete.

interface_controls.purpose: 用代码结构索引辅助理解影响范围，但不替代 rg、validator、代码审查和 Git。
safety_rules: codegraph may update only ignored index files
codegraph results are context candidates, not authority for source changes
interface_controls.failure_behavior: If the index is stale or unavailable, fall back to rg and validators.

allowed_engine_patterns: BM25 plus semantic rerank as a future optional retrieval adapter
QMD-style semantic search only after a separate proposal, benchmark, and validator gate
codegraph structural code index as a local context adapter
CodeGraph structural code index as an on-demand local context adapter
hard_limits: no full transcript ingestion by default
semantic hits are candidates, not source-of-truth rules
no unvetted vector database by default
external memory services are not default runtime adapters

allowed_auto_actions: append deduplicated observed events to evolution_backlog.json
commit only allowlisted low-risk changes after gates pass
use codegraph status for local repository context health
use codegraph CLI status for local repository context health when explicitly requested
forbidden_auto_actions: write runtime skill cache or plugin cache
scan or mutate protected private-skill-workspace content
ingest full chat transcript by default
auto-promote medium or high risk backlog items
let codegraph index become a source-of-truth rule store
enable external memory hooks or memory MCP by default
run external memory services as startup dependencies

startup_checks: git tracked worktree is clean before write-capable automation
protected runtime paths are recorded by path only
last memory status report is readable

runtime_derivative: local memory status and reconciliation reports

runtime_adapter_policy.engine: envctl memory commands, local reports, decision archive, evolution backlog, Obsidian/Zotero/Git records
codex_integration: <CODEX_HOME>/hooks.json has no external memory lifecycle hooks
<CODEX_HOME>/config.toml has no default external memory MCP block
Codex native memory may keep only compact entry preferences and pointers to source rules
allowed_actions: memory candidate scoring through envctl memory score
local memory status and reconciliation reports
promotion only through schema, validator, user confirmation, and Git review
CodeGraph CLI context as optional code-structure evidence
forbidden_actions: auto-promote runtime memory into source rules
write AGENTS, skills, schemas, routing, or control kernel without envctl validators
inject recalled context into a route switch without asking the user
enable external memory hooks, automatic prompt injection, or full transcript import by default
store secrets, cookies, account data, captcha state, or private project paths as global memory
runtime_adapter_policy.promotion_boundary: local_memory_system, memory_admission_policy, control_kernel, envctl validators, and Git commits decide durable memory promotion.
runtime_adapter_policy.health_check: python -m skills.scripts.envctl memory status --summary and memory reconcile reports are authoritative for local memory health; external memory services are treated as optional experiments only.
